name: support-route
description: Route a support message to billing or technical support.
instructions: Select one support action. Select no_match when neither action applies.
noMatchCriteria: Requests unrelated to billing or technical support.

actions.label: billing
actions.criteria: Questions about invoices, payments, or refunds.

actions.label: technical
actions.criteria: Questions about bugs, outages, or technical problems.

examples.message: I have a question about my invoice.
The application crashes when I log in.
